title: Stack Pack manifest v1
description: aoforge-stack.json at a stack pack plugin's root, mirrored to ~/.claude/aoforge/stacks/<name>/ by the pack's SessionStart hook. See docs/PROPOSAL-stack-packs.md §5A. Paths are relative to the pack root. Detection files, generated-file globs and runtime defaults belong in the pack's profiles, not here (PROPOSAL-stack-profile.md §8); the manifest keeps the executable concerns.

name.description: Pack id: the stacks/<name>/ mirror directory and the config stacks.enabled key.

plugin.description: The Claude Code plugin name that ships the pack; its agents are addressed <plugin>:<agent>.

contract.description: Contract version the pack implements. Core refuses one it does not support.

profiles.description: Tier-2 stack profiles the pack ships. A project whose extends chain names one of their ids activates the pack.

detect.description: Repo evidence that PROPOSES the pack in `stack discover`. Detection never activates a pack.

fragments.description: Per-agent instruction files. `stack context <agent>` points the agent at the active packs' fragment for it.

subagents.description: Pack agents a core agent delegates to, keyed by the core agent.

models.description: Tier per profile for the pack's own agents, read by `aof-tools resolve-model <agent>`.

cli.description: The pack's own Node CLI entry, run as `node <mirror>/<cli> <args>`.

requires_tool.description: External binaries the pack drives, name -> version range (informational; presence is checked).

ui.description: Stack inputs to the stack-neutral Surface Spec pipeline.

select.description: Selection by the resolved profile's frontmatter, besides a profile id in the extends chain: e.g. {"runtime": ["web"]} activates the pack for verification.runtime: web.

soft_depends.description: Packs this pack wants for some platforms without requiring them. When this pack is active and the project's platforms (the resolved verification.runtime, and every TRD's platform / must_haves.platform) include one listed here, the named pack is selected too, unless config stacks.disabled names it. A named pack that is not installed, not enabled or broken is a `stack doctor` warning, never a failure. Not followed transitively.

gate_policy.description: A module exporting the pack's run-guard policy for `stack verify --run`: guardedTools, deny, binDirs, rewrite(command, {cwdAbs, root, fs}).

awareness.description: A module that lets org-awareness read the pack's language in the shared library repo: extensions, entrypoints(root, fs), parseExports(source).
